title: SF1634 (2021-2022 Regular): Information collected and scope of background check conducted for noncitizen permit to carry applicants expansion

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2021-02-26; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2021/0/SF/1634/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text. The IAQ sentence carries no strike mark, so it may be new or existing law; the text file cannot tell. A check for permit eligibility is not treated as a deportation topic. Struck text left out of quotes. Version read: introduced text (as filed). No passage vote is recorded for this bill.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the applicant's country of birth and alien number or alien admission number.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 4): In addition, if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the sheriff must ensure that an Immigration Alien Query (IAQ) check is performed on the applicant.
